What are CSS class names for flairs on Voat? I'm trying to add one for expired free steam giveaways.

Hi!

To create a flair for your subverse, you go to flair settings and you create a new link flair. Name the CSS class name something that won't confuse the rest of your CSS so I used flair-announcement, flair-discussion, flair-question, etc. You can name them anything you want because the flair label is custom, in this case you're going to want the class name to be something like flair-expired with a label of 'Expired', you can also save some time and call them something simpler like fl-expired or fl-exp, as long as you know what the code is referring to!

To add them in through the CSS, you go to subverse settings and in your custom stylesheet, you edit in the following:

.flair-announcement {
 display: inline-block; 
}

Or whatever else you chose to name your flair class anywhere in the style sheet, this makes the flair appear on your subverse. You can also customize the colours of flairs too if you want to. Then that's that!

Hope this helps!
